title: Composable policy validation pipeline with staged adapters for region/tier fallback rules
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Goal: Replace the monolithic routing rule validator with a composable pipeline made of small, testable validator "checks" plus staged adapters that can migrate legacy DSL variants to the canonical schema at validation time. This will make it easier to add new rule types (region weighting, tiered fallbacks, variant chains) and to provide precise, actionable lint messages and automated fix suggestions.

Scope:
- Implement a validation pipeline that runs an ordered list of check modules: syntactic checks, semantic checks (types/refs), capability checks (model+region compatibility), cost/latency heuristic checks, and safety constraints.
- Add staged adapters that transform older routing rule shapes into canonical ASTs before validation, enabling rollback-free schema evolution.
- Expose a lightweight diagnostic API for the Console and CLI that returns structured issues and suggested patches (patches are textual edits, not opaque errors).
- Add a migration tool that diffs existing rule sets and generates adapter configs for customers with minimal manual edits.

Out of scope for this ticket: runtime enforcement hooks, UI-side rollout controls, and autoscaling adaptations. Those will follow after the validation pipeline ships.
acceptance_criteria: New validator runs as a library and can validate a routing policy file producing a list of issues with severity and suggested fixes.
Staged adapter mechanism can transform two legacy DSL variants (v1 and v1.1) to the canonical schema in tests.
Integration tests cover region selection, tier preference, and fallback-to-variant chains with at least 90% rule coverage.
Console diagnostic API can return up to 50 issues for a 1MB ruleset within 300ms in CI emulation.
Migration tool can produce a deterministic diff and a best-effort adapter for >95% of customer rulesets in the internal sample corpus.
migration_plan: 1) Implement pipeline core and adapter interface behind a feature flag. 2) Add adapters for v1 and v1.1 rule shapes. 3) Run internal lint against known customer rulesets and collect failure modes. 4) Iterate on adapter heuristics and ship migration tool as beta to selected customers. 5) Deprecate feature flag after 2 cycles.
testing_plan: Unit tests for each check module (syntactic, semantic, capability, cost, safety). End-to-end validation tests with fixture rulesets (happy, malformed, malicious). Performance microbenchmarks in CI with 1000 small rulesets and 50 large ones. Regression harness runs against the internal corpus and fails CI if diagnostics count deviates >5% from baseline. Add fuzzing job to the pipeline that mutates rule trees and ensures validator does not crash.
decisions: Represent canonical rule model as a light AST (JSON tree) with explicit versioning field.
Adapters are pure, idempotent transforms that introduce a hint metadata block when they make non-lossless changes.
Checks are independent modules and must not mutate the AST; suggested fixes return patch objects applied by the migration tool.
blockers: Need a consistent corpus of customer rulesets sanitized for PII before running migration experiments.
Perf benchmarks need dedicated CI runners; coordinate with infra to provision temporary machines.
notes: Early prototype showed a 30% reduction in false-positive safety errors because adapter normalisation removed ambiguous region aliases. Plan to present a demo at the 2026-03-20 engineering sync. Consider adding a 'dry-run' lint endpoint for the Console so customers can preview auto-migrations.
